risk_note: RV2 (identity, account and authorization boundary; BR-ID-05, BR-ID-06, BR-ID-08; D10-2189 / D10-2192 / D10-2215 / D10-2216 / D10-2217 / D10-2236). POST /v1/me/phone now changes a bound number: withStepUp(phone_change) with the verified token passed to the service and judged under the users row lock (an account that has a phone needs a verified phone_change token whose phone_binding claim matches the locked phone_hmac, else 10003; a revoked session 10002), the new number's bind code, account.phone_change_enabled read uncached and only the boolean false disables (30414 at the change, at sms-codes step_up/phone_change after the signature and before 20001, at step-up phone_change after 10405 and before the code check; no change to rate-limit order), a new number equal to the current one 20001 [phone], 44001 before 30411 (status<>'deleted' owners including deleting; a number only on deleted accounts can be taken; a concurrent unique conflict also 30411), the old phone_hmac into deleted_identities (phone_changed, 180 days), in the same transaction every other session of the account revoked (the current sid kept) and one audit_logs row through admin's system audit writer (system_actor system:self_service, action user_phone_change, target users:<uid>, before / after only phone_masked 3+4). Contract: audit_system_actor and AdminAuditSystemActor gain system:self_service (contract slot held, D10-2217). Hardening from the money review: SMS login re-checks the number's owner under the row lock inside a savepoint (one candidate lock at a time); third-party step-up no longer issues phone_change (20001 [action]). First binding unchanged; idempotency key derivation unchanged (D10-2165 ① open).

reviews.note: Codex money review via tools/agent/codex-run.sh (implementation by Opus, approvals 27). r1 fail: 3 S0 + 1 S2 (first binding racing a change skipped the old-number check; a revoked in-flight session could still change; SMS login could get a session on the account after the change; third-party step-up could issue phone_change) - fixed in r2. r2: all four closed, 1 S1 (SMS login held the old owner's row lock while locking the new owner, deadlock risk with id-ordered credit transactions) - fixed in r3 with a savepoint. r3 (incremental): pass, no findings (couli-runs/B1-20b/review-money-codex-r1.json, -r2.json, -r3.json).

spec_test_review.note: Rule tests by Codex (gpt-6.2-sol, ledger tester codex, attempts 1 and 2), so the spec-test review went to a fresh independent Claude (approvals 19; D10-2199's full Codex spec-test round does not apply when Codex wrote the tests). r1 fail: 2 S1 (deleting owner -> 30411 and a number only on a deleted account can be taken were untested) + an out-of-scope S2 (concurrency case rarely reached the unique-conflict path) - attempt 2 added both cases and made the concurrency case wait until both requests are blocked on the users write. r2 pass. Remaining out-of-scope S2 (/v1/config client copy of the switch, content module) filed as FU-CONFIG-PHONE-CHANGE-FLAG.
